mentions.name: staaash
mentions.description: Self-hosted cloud drive, a Google Drive alternative that runs on your own server. The v2 release adds a desktop app with sync, redesigns the whole web app, and follows a near-complete rewrite of the codebase.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a self-hosted cloud drive (like a Google Drive alternative to run on your own server), about to release v2.
mentions.author: itsmeares
